hyena: An adult spotted hyena standing on all four legs seen from the side, with the unmistakable hyena silhouette and NOT the build of a dog: TALL POWERFUL FRONT LEGS AND MASSIVE HIGH SHOULDERS, the back SLOPING STEEPLY DOWNWARD so the rump sits far below the shoulder, and a THICK HEAVY NECK as wide as the head. A SHORT ERECT RUFF OF COARSE DARK HAIR STANDS UP ALONG THE NECK AND SHOULDERS, raised into a crest. The head is LARGE, BROAD AND BLUNT with enormous jaw muscles bulging at the cheeks - a bone-crushing skull, not a slender dog muzzle - with SMALL ROUNDED EARS, not pointed. Coarse sandy-ginger coat covered in dark irregular blotchy spots, a short bushy dark-tipped tail. Heavy, top-heavy and thickset.
stripedhyena: A striped hyena standing on all four legs seen from the side, with the unmistakable hyena silhouette: tall powerful front legs and high muscular shoulders, the back sloping steeply downward to noticeably lower and shorter hindquarters so the rump sits far below the shoulders. Shaggy grey fur with vertical black stripes, a tall erect mane of long hair along the neck and spine, and a large blunt head. The steeply sloping back is essential and it must not be level-backed like a wolf
brownhyena: A brown hyena standing on all four legs seen from the side, with the unmistakable hyena silhouette: high muscular shoulders and long front legs, the back sloping steeply down to much lower hindquarters. Long shaggy dark brown fur hanging in a cape over the shoulders, pale horizontally striped legs, and a large blunt head. The steeply sloping back is essential and it must not be level-backed like a wolf or a lion
